integrity: The optimization value is an elementary prerequisite and is not asserted to be a new scalar result. Bibliographic coverage may miss unindexed or unpublished results. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Counts only minimum-weight outer-independent two-rainbow functions of \(K_m\square K_n\), with \(2\le m\le n\), and with graph coordinates and both colors labeled. Does not count higher-dimensional products, arbitrary graph products, or nonminimum functions. Finite verification does not replace the all-parameter proof.
title: Exact multiplicities of minimum outer-independent two-rainbow functions on rook graphs
